# phpseclib - PHP Secure Communications Library | master | 4.0 | 3.0 | 2.0 | 1.0 | |:------:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | [![CI Status](https://img.shields.io/github/check-runs/phpseclib/phpseclib/master?label=CI "CI Status")](https://github.com/phpseclib/phpseclib/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amaster) | [![CI Status](https://img.shields.io/github/check-runs/phpseclib/phpseclib/4.0?label=CI "CI Status")](https://github.com/phpseclib/phpseclib/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3A4.0) | [![CI Status](https://img.shields.io/github/check-runs/phpseclib/phpseclib/3.0?label=CI "CI Status")](https://github.com/phpseclib/phpseclib/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3A3.0) | [![CI Status](https://img.shields.io/github/check-runs/phpseclib/phpseclib/2.0?label=CI "CI Status")](https://github.com/phpseclib/phpseclib/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3A2.0) | [![CI Status](https://img.shields.io/github/check-runs/phpseclib/phpseclib/1.0?label=CI "CI Status")](https://github.com/phpseclib/phpseclib/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3A1.0) | ## Supporting phpseclib - [Become a backer or sponsor on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/phpseclib) - [One-time donation via PayPal or crypto-currencies](http://sourceforge.net/donate/index.php?group_id=198487) - [Subscribe to Tidelift](https://tidelift.com/subscription/pkg/packagist-phpseclib-phpseclib?utm_source=packagist-phpseclib-phpseclib&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme) ## Introduction MIT-licensed pure-PHP implementations of the following: SSH-2, SFTP, X.509, an arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic library, Ed25519 / Ed449 / Curve25519 / Curve449, ECDSA / ECDH (with support for 66 curves), RSA (PKCS#1 v2.2 compliant), DSA / DH, DES / 3DES / RC4 / Rijndael / AES / Blowfish / Twofish / Salsa20 / ChaCha20, GCM / Poly1305 * [Browse Git](https://github.com/phpseclib/phpseclib) ## Documentation * [Documentation / Manual](https://phpseclib.com/) * API Documentation (generated by Doctum): [master](https://api.phpseclib.com/master/), [3.0](https://api.phpseclib.com/3.0/), [2.0](https://api.phpseclib.com/2.0/), [1.0](https://api.phpseclib.com/1.0/) ## Branches ### master * Development Branch * Unstable API * Do not use in production ### 4.0 * Long term support (LTS) release * X509 split into separate X509, CRL, CSR and SPKAC classes * PFX and CMS classes added * All ASN1 classes are lazy loaded by default * Minimum PHP version: 8.1.0 * PSR-4 autoloading with namespace rooted at `\phpseclib4` * Install via Composer: `composer require phpseclib/phpseclib:~4.0` ### 3.0 * Long term support (LTS) release * Major expansion of cryptographic primitives * Minimum PHP version: 5.6.1 * PSR-4 autoloading with namespace rooted at `\phpseclib3` * Install via Composer: `composer require phpseclib/phpseclib:~3.0` ### 2.0 * Long term support (LTS) release * Modernized version of 1.0 * Minimum PHP version: 5.3.3 * PSR-4 autoloading with namespace rooted at `\phpseclib` * Install via Composer: `composer require phpseclib/phpseclib:~2.0` ### 1.0 * Long term support (LTS) release * PHP4 compatible * Composer compatible (PSR-0 autoloading) * Install using Composer: `composer require phpseclib/phpseclib:~1.0` * [Download 1.0.30 as ZIP](http://sourceforge.net/projects/phpseclib/files/phpseclib1.0.30.zip/download) ## Security contact information To report a security vulnerability, please use the [Tidelift security contact](https://tidelift.com/security). Tidelift will coordinate the fix and disclosure. ## Support Need Support? * [Checkout Questions and Answers on Stack Overflow](http://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/phpseclib) * [Create a Support Ticket on GitHub](https://github.com/phpseclib/phpseclib/issues/new) ## Special Thanks
